items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2NzM3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--39d4604caacd6b9abe7f1d40fa870948cb5da415/LogoBLDRL.png)

Pirmā ātrkubošanas līga Latvijā! Sacenties par **Rīgas Blind meistara** titulu!
Ņemiet vērā, ka šajās sacensībās **nebūs** populāro disciplīnu (2x2, 3x3, pyraminx u.tml.)! Pārliecinieties kārtīgi, vai šīs sacensības ir piemērotas Jūsu prasmēm!
Ierobežotās telpas dēļ līdzi atļauts ņemt **tikai 1 viesi** uz dalībnieku.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The first speedcubing league in Latvia! Compete for the title of **Riga Blind Master**!
Please note that this competition does **not** hold the popular events (2x2, 3x3, pyraminx etc.)! Check carefuly if this is a kind of competition You would be able to participate in!
Competition will take place in a limited space. You may bring at most **only one guest** per competitor.

L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#71518-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**.

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#71518-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.information:

Welcome to **Los Baños Speedcubing Open 2026**, the first speedcubing event in Los Baños, Laguna! This competition features the events 3x3, 2x2, 3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Clock and Square-1 with 3x3 as the main event.

We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.

This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.

items.name: Rowland Heights Fall A 2026

venue.name: Tawa Marketplace Rowland Heights
venue.address: Mandarin Plaza, 1015 S Nogales St, Rowland Heights, CA 91748

items.information:
## Registration for this competition is now closed as we already have an extensive waitlist. We will not be accepting any new registrations at this time.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RowlandHeightsFallA2026#76810-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

**This competition is run in series with [Rowland Heights Fall B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RowlandHeightsFallB2026).** You can only register for one of the two competitions!

**This competition takes place in a public marketplace, so expect the venue to be noisy, and prepare accordingly.**

**This competition will use running judges for all rounds.**

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
